chunks.text:
“The Guideline for Japanese Government’s Procurements and Utilizations of Generative AI for the sake of Evolution and Innovation of Public Administration” Ver 2.0 (Overview) (Provisional Translation) 2026/6

(1) Purpose and Scheme of this Guideline, etc. Purpose: Boost uses and secure risk managements of generative AI in the Japanese Government, by organizing propelling measures, governance, procurement, and utilization of generative AI. Target: Generative AI systems that are, in principle, capable of accepting text and audio as input and generating text, images, or audio as output. *Not applied to systems handling information of sensitive fields such as national security, maintenance of public security and order Implementation of this Guideline: Had come into effect in May 2025. The contents of Version 2.0 will come into effect on September 1, 2026. (The scope subject to the AI governance framework will apply from July 1, 2026.)
